sampling: Purposive eight-description portfolio sample across US/UK/Ireland and several seniority levels; includes closed/indexed descriptions. It is neither a representative market sample nor a vacancy-count time series.
missing_semantics: A skill not coded is unobserved in this sample coding, not proof that the employer does not require it.

queries.skill_mentions: SELECT skill, label, COUNT(DISTINCT job_id) AS descriptions, SUM(level='required') AS explicitly_required, SUM(level='preferred') AS preferred FROM requirements GROUP BY skill,label ORDER BY descriptions DESC,skill
queries.family_skills: SELECT j.family, r.label, COUNT(*) AS descriptions FROM jobs j JOIN requirements r USING(job_id) GROUP BY j.family,r.label ORDER BY j.family,descriptions DESC,r.label
queries.sample_coverage: SELECT geography,access_state,COUNT(*) AS descriptions FROM jobs GROUP BY geography,access_state ORDER BY geography,access_state
queries.seniority: SELECT seniority,COUNT(*) AS descriptions FROM jobs GROUP BY seniority ORDER BY descriptions DESC,seniority
queries.resource_completeness: SELECT COUNT(*) AS resources, SUM(provider_hours IS NOT NULL) AS observed_duration, SUM(provider_hours IS NULL) AS duration_needs_assumption, SUM(provider_fee=0) AS free_content_access FROM learning
